newsitem.title: UK: UK's Littlewoods frontrunner for Freemans - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Littlewoods frontrunner for Freemans - paper.

text.p: British retailing and pools group Littlewoods is the main contender to buy the Freemans mail-order business from Sears for between 350 million stg and 400 million stg, according to a Sunday newspaper report.
The Sunday Times said talks between Freemans and Littlewoods, Britain's largest private company, are at an "advance stage," the report said.
Other contenders for a sale which could be concluded by Chistmas are the Manchester-based group N Brown and German mail order group Otto Versand, in continuing talks with Sears.
The paper said the decision to offload Freemans would be popular with City analysts, but Sears was unlikely to realise anything like the 477 million stg it paid for Freemans in 1988.
